patterns.name: Hardcoded Private Key
patterns.description: Private key or seed phrase hardcoded in source code
patterns.recommendation: Never hardcode private keys. Use environment variables or secure key management

patterns.name: Hidden Fund Transfer
patterns.description: Silent transfer of funds to hardcoded or obfuscated address
patterns.recommendation: Review all fund transfer destinations. Remove hardcoded addresses

patterns.name: Obfuscated Code
patterns.description: Base64 encoded or obfuscated code that may hide malicious logic
patterns.recommendation: Remove all obfuscated code. All logic should be readable and auditable

patterns.name: Data Exfiltration
patterns.description: Sending sensitive data to external servers
patterns.recommendation: Audit all outbound network requests for data leaks

patterns.name: Dynamic Import of External Code
patterns.description: Dynamically importing code from external URLs at runtime
patterns.recommendation: Never dynamically import code from external URLs

patterns.name: Hidden Eval Execution
patterns.description: Using eval() or Function() constructor to execute dynamic code
patterns.recommendation: Remove all eval() and Function() constructor usage

patterns.name: Prototype Pollution
patterns.description: Object property assignment that could lead to prototype pollution
patterns.recommendation: Validate object keys and use Object.create(null) for dictionaries

patterns.name: Process Environment Exfiltration
patterns.description: Accessing and potentially leaking environment variables
patterns.recommendation: Never send environment variables to external services

patterns.name: File System Access
patterns.description: Reading sensitive files like SSH keys, wallets, or config files
patterns.recommendation: Restrict file system access to only necessary paths

patterns.name: Command Injection
patterns.description: Executing shell commands with user-controlled input
patterns.recommendation: Avoid shell execution. If necessary, sanitize all inputs

patterns.name: Malicious NPM Lifecycle Script
patterns.description: Package.json scripts that execute on install, potentially malicious
patterns.recommendation: Review all lifecycle scripts in package.json for malicious commands

patterns.name: SQL Injection
patterns.recommendation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements

patterns.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
patterns.description: Inserting user input into HTML without sanitization
patterns.recommendation: Sanitize all user input before DOM insertion. Use textContent instead

patterns.name: Insecure Random
patterns.recommendation: Use crypto.randomBytes() or crypto.getRandomValues() for security

patterns.name: Weak Cryptography
patterns.description: Using weak or broken cryptographic algorithms
patterns.recommendation: Use SHA-256 or stronger. Use AES-256-GCM for encryption

patterns.name: Exposed API Keys
patterns.description: API keys or tokens in frontend code
patterns.recommendation: Move API keys to server-side. Never include in client code
